welcome: Hi, I'm the Medicount Billing Assistant. 👋 I can help with questions about an ambulance or EMS bill — payments, balances, insurance, records requests, and more. Please share only the details requested for your billing question.
prechat: Before we begin, please share a few details so we can assist you and follow up if the chat disconnects.
emergency: 🚨 If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 right now or go to the nearest emergency room. This chat can only help with billing questions and cannot provide medical help. Please get help immediately.
agent: I'm an automated assistant, and this chat doesn't transfer to a live agent. But you're not stuck: • I can handle most billing requests right here • Anything I can't resolve is submitted to our billing team, who respond in writing within 1 business day • Or call us at 888-410-6986, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time Want to try me first?
card: ⚠️ Please don't share payment card or bank account numbers in this chat. For your protection, that message has been flagged for restriction and payments are only accepted on our secure payment page. Would you like me to open the secure page instead?
verification: To protect your privacy, I need to verify your identity before sharing anything about an account. I can't confirm whether an account exists until verification succeeds.
lockout: I wasn't able to verify your identity after several attempts, so I can't share account details in this chat. You can call us at 888-410-6986, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time, or leave your contact details and our team will reach out to help verify you securely.
fallback: I want to make sure I get this right. Did you mean one of these?
closure: Is there anything else I can help you with today?
insuranceUpdate: Enter your updated insurance information and review it before submitting.
